title: Plastics Business Equity Stake For Sale in Al-Suwaira, Iraq
tagline: Located in Al-Suwaira, business specializes in manufacturing PVC electrical conduits and fittings, with a strong focus on 25 mm conduits. - The products are essential for protecting and organizing electrical wiring across residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. - Business serves a wide range of customers, including electrical contractors, construction companies, wholesalers, retailers, and electrical supply stores throughout Iraq. - The revenue primarily comes from the sales of our high-quality PVC conduits and fittings. - With 20 skilled employees, we have built an efficient production facility equipped with the right machinery for quality output. - The business has deep roots in the local market, supported by strong relationships with suppliers and a solid customer base.
